name: Automatic status update for AMC and Warranty
Restore Asset from scrap when req delete
script:
if doc.asset:

    frappe.db.set_value(
        "Asset",
        doc.asset,
        "status",
        "Submitted",   # or "Active" based on your system
        update_modified=False
    )

    frappe.msgprint(f"Asset {doc.asset} restored from Scrapped.")

name: status to scrapped in asset
script:
if doc.status == "Approved" and doc.asset:

    status = frappe.db.get_value("Asset", doc.asset, "status")

    if status != "Scrapped":
        frappe.db.set_value(
            "Asset",
            doc.asset,
            "status",
            "Scrapped",
            update_modified=False
        )

        frappe.msgprint(f"Asset {doc.asset} marked as Scrapped.")
